title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan wants US open-weight AI labs to ‘distill’ frontier models, too
slides: Why does Garry Tan want US labs to copy China?

thread_text:
1. Copy China, Says Investor

Garry Tan tells US labs to distill frontier models from rivals. The catch: it may break export rules.

2. Distill or Steal?

Open-weight labs are urged to mimic top models. That shortcut could trigger legal trouble with US regulators.

3. Export Rules Bite Back

Distilling from a frontier model may violate US export controls. Your compliance team should be worried.

4. Compliance Checks Incoming

Startups training models face new scrutiny. If your data touches a frontier model, expect questions.

5. Audit Your Data Now

Check if your training pipeline uses outputs from a frontier model. If yes, get legal advice this week. Does your model pass?
